steps.check: 준비 — 재고매입(바이어 미정) — 같은 바이어 매입 락과 무관
준비 — 첨부가 문서뿐이라 계좌 찾기는 바로 끝남(GPU 안 부름)
준비 — ERP 로 넘어감(사진 0·계좌 찾기 끝)
steps.db: select status, car_erp_vehicle_id is not null as has_erp, payee_extraction_status, (select count(*) from inspection_photos p where p.purchase_listing_id = l.id and p.kind = 'sales_photo') as photos from purchase_listings l where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null and created_at >= ?

steps.check: 2단계 — 요청 저장(보냄 · 홈플 · ERP 위치 전송)
steps.db: select t.status, t.revision, t.stock_location, t.erp_location_synced_at is not null as loc_synced, t.erp_location_error, (select count(*) from transport_request_recipients r where r.transport_request_id = t.id and r.kind = 'company_phone') > 0 as company_phones from transport_requests t join purchase_listings l on l.id = t.purchase_listing_id where l.vehicle_number = ? and l.deleted_at is null and t.created_at >= ?

steps.check: 3단계 — 알림톡은 로컬에서 꺼져 있어 안 나감(발송 0)
steps.db: select count(*) as sent from transport_request_recipients r join transport_requests t on t.id = r.transport_request_id join purchase_listings l on l.id = t.purchase_listing_id where l.vehicle_number = ? and l.deleted_at is null and r.sent_status = 'sent' and t.created_at >= ?

select t.status, t.decided_name, t.decided_recipient_id is not null as has_who from transport_requests t join purchase_listings l on l.id = t.purchase_listing_id where l.vehicle_number = ? and l.deleted_at is null and t.created_at >= ?

steps.text: 배차가 끝났습니다. ERP 로 매입잔금 요청을 보내면 배차 정보가 메모로 함께 갑니다.

steps.db: select t.balance_requested_at is not null as sent, t.balance_request_error from transport_requests t join purchase_listings l on l.id = t.purchase_listing_id where l.vehicle_number = ? and l.deleted_at is null and t.created_at >= ?

steps.check: 7단계 — ERP 매입잔금 요청(배차 정보 메모·미지급 전액)
steps.db: select count(*) as n, max(e.error) as err, max(json_unquote(json_extract(e.request_payload, '$.type'))) as type, max(json_unquote(json_extract(e.request_payload, '$.note'))) like '배차: 위카%' as note_ok, max(json_extract(e.request_payload, '$.amount_krw')) > 0 as has_amount from integration_events e join purchase_listings l on json_extract(e.request_payload, '$.vehicle_ids[0]') = l.car_erp_vehicle_id where e.event_type = 'board_request' and l.vehicle_number = ? and l.deleted_at is null and e.created_at >= ?
